Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly assumed that the document contained a "Gift Assignments" section listing who gave gifts to whom. The document only provided a list of employees, a list of profiles (interests), and a list of gifts received. It did not explicitly state who gave which gift. By hallucinating the existence of assignment data and manually mapping gifts to recipients based on hobbies without any explicit source in the text, the agent failed to accurately extract the data as required by the plan (Step 1 of the manager's plan). This led to a flawed deduction that Rebecca did not give a gift, when in reality, the problem cannot be solved solely by matching gifts to hobbies because the giver-recipient pairs are not provided in the text. The core error was the failure to recognize the missing information and the subsequent fabrication of data to force a solution.
